detail.longDescription: Got a Dell Optiplex 5070 with the idea to start building a homelab. It came with 8gb DDR4 and I had additional 32gb laying around. Installed those. Next I wanted to install 2x 1TB Samsung Evo 870 SSDs. Turns out the freaking box comes with a 6 pin proprietary Sata power cable. So although it has more than 1 Sata connectors, by default it comes with one Sata power. Now I need to buy a Sata Y splitter and allow it to attach the additional disks. # homelab # selfhosted
